segments.an8.7:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante devadatte.
segments.an8.7:1.2: Tatra bhagavā devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an8.7:1.3: “sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.7:1.4: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.7:1.5: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.7:1.6: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.7:1.7: Aṭṭhahi, bhikkhave, asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho”.
segments.an8.7:2.2: Lābhena hi, bhikkhave, abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
segments.an8.7:2.3: Alābhena, bhikkhave … pe … yasena, bhikkhave … ayasena, bhikkhave … sakkārena, bhikkhave … asakkārena, bhikkhave … pāpicchatāya, bhikkhave … pāpamittatāya, bhikkhave, abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
segments.an8.7:2.10: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
segments.an8.7:3.1: “Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya.
segments.an8.7:4.1: “Kiñca [kathañca (ka.)], bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya?
segments.an8.7:5.1: “Yaṃ hissa, bhikkhave, uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anabhibhuyya [anabhibhūyya anabhibhūyya (ka.)] viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya [abhibhūyya abhibhūyya (ka.)] viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
segments.an8.7:5.2: Yaṃ hissa, bhikkhave, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
segments.an8.7:5.9: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya.
segments.an8.7:6.2: ‘uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya viharissāma, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya viharissāmā’ti.
